name: comp-139
blurb: Multiple checkboxes arranged horizontally in a row.
description: Horizontal checkbox group with three pre-made options (React, Next.js, Astro). Demonstrates multi-select layout with flexbox gap.
use_when: Presenting multiple independent options that fit horizontally.
avoid_when: Many options—use a vertical layout or checkbox group component for scalability.
a11y: Each checkbox properly labeled and associated. Full keyboard navigation. No ARIA group.
